metadata.title: Seedance API: Access, Pricing, Providers & Examples
metadata.description: Learn how Seedance API access works across Seedance 2.0 and 2.5, including model IDs, API keys, pricing, providers, asynchronous tasks, and examples.

hero.title: Seedance API
hero.description: A practical Seedance API overview for developers comparing official access, provider documentation, API keys, Seedance API pricing, task creation, video inputs, and production safeguards.
hero.tip: Availability, pricing, and supported settings can vary by provider, region, and plan.

introduce.title: What a Seedance API integration includes
introduce.description: Generic searches for Seedance API, Seedance 2.0 API, Seedance 2 API, and Seedance 2.5 documentation often mix official ModelArk endpoints with third-party wrappers. Start from the provider contract.

items.title: Choose the model version
items.description: Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 have different model IDs, input limits, output options, and rollout status. Record the exact version.

items.title: Protect the API key
items.description: Create credentials in the provider console and keep them on a server or trusted edge function. Never ship a secret in client JavaScript.

items.title: Submit an asynchronous task
items.description: Video generation normally returns a task ID first. Poll or receive the documented callback, then fetch and verify the result.

items.title: Budget the request
items.description: Estimate cost from duration, resolution, references, audio, plan, and region. Store enough request metadata to explain the final bill.

benefits.title: Common Seedance API workflows
benefits.description: Match the API shape to the creative job instead of forcing every use case through one prompt field.

items.title: Text-to-video
items.description: Send a shot brief with subject, action, camera, lighting, timing, audio direction, and constraints.

items.title: Image-to-video
items.description: Use a first frame or image reference to anchor composition, product appearance, or character identity.

items.title: Reference and edit video
items.description: Pass a source clip and clearly state which motion, background, camera, or subject attributes should change.

items.title: Production monitoring
items.description: Track queue time, status, retries, provider errors, output URLs, retention windows, and moderation outcomes.

features.title: Seedance API implementation checklist
features.description: A small, observable proof of concept makes provider changes and version upgrades easier to manage.

items.title: Read the current docs
items.description: Confirm endpoint, region, authentication, model ID, content schema, and parameter ranges.

items.title: Validate input assets
items.description: Check public URL reachability, file format, size, duration, aspect ratio, and rights.

items.title: Create one task
items.description: Use a short prompt and minimal reference set so any failure has a clear cause.

items.title: Handle status transitions
items.description: Make polling, callbacks, retries, and duplicate notifications idempotent.

items.title: Verify the output file
items.description: Inspect actual dimensions, duration, audio, watermark, and playback rather than trusting the request.

items.title: Log cost and policy
items.description: Keep provider, version, settings, price estimate, and moderation reason with the task record.

faq.title: Seedance API FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: Is there an official Seedance API?
items.answer: BytePlus ModelArk publishes official API documentation for supported Seedance model versions and markets. Use the current provider reference as the integration contract.

items.question: What is the Seedance 2 API (Seedance 2.0 API)?
items.answer: It is the provider API surface for supported Seedance 2.0 video generation workflows. The model ID, input schema, output limits, and price should be copied from current documentation.

items.question: What is the Seedance 2.5 API?
items.answer: BytePlus ModelArk currently documents a Seedance 2.5 video-generation model in supported markets. See the dedicated guide for version-specific access and request planning.

items.question: How do I get a Seedance API key?
items.answer: Create an account with a supported provider, complete any required verification, enable the relevant service, and create a server-side credential according to its current documentation.

items.question: What is Seedance API pricing, and what is the Seedance API price?
items.answer: Cost varies by model, duration, resolution, input video, account plan, and region. Compare a real request using the provider’s current price table or calculator.

items.question: Does Seadance Video provide a public API?
items.answer: No. This site provides a browser-based generator and informational pages. It is not an official Seedance API provider or a substitute for provider documentation.

cta.title: Start with the official API contract
cta.description: Read the provider docs, run one authorized task, and verify the returned video before building a larger Seedance integration.
